title: Custom Software Development
summary: Web platforms, internal tools and APIs, built to scale with your business.
intro: We design and build software that fits the way your company actually works: customer portals, internal tools, back-office systems and the APIs that connect them.
Every project is led by a senior engineer and delivered in two-week sprints, so you see working software early and often.

sections.heading: What we build
paragraphs: Most of our projects are business-critical systems that off-the-shelf software cannot handle well.
bullets: Integrations with ERP, CRM and legacy systems

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: We start with a short discovery phase, agree on a scope and a release plan, and then build in sprints. You have direct access to the engineers doing the work.

title: Cloud Migration & DevOps
summary: Move legacy systems to AWS, Azure or GCP, with CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
intro: We move on-premise and legacy systems to the cloud without stopping your business, then set up the pipelines and monitoring that keep them healthy.
For manufacturing clients we often design hybrid setups, where factory systems stay on-site and reporting and analytics move to the cloud.

sections.heading: Our migration approach
paragraphs: We map every system and dependency first, then migrate in small, reversible steps. Nothing is switched off until the new setup has run in parallel and been verified.

title: Manufacturing & Industrial Software
summary: MES, factory dashboards and integration with equipment and ERP systems.
intro: We build software for the factory floor: manufacturing execution systems, equipment data collection, yield and quality dashboards, and the integrations between them and your ERP.
Our engineers understand production constraints. We plan releases around maintenance windows and never put a running line at risk.
benefits: Experience with semiconductor and electronics fabs

title: Data & AI Solutions
summary: Data pipelines, analytics dashboards, and AI features that work in real products.
intro: We turn the data you already have into decisions: clean pipelines, reliable dashboards, and practical AI features such as forecasting, anomaly detection and document processing.
We focus on AI that earns its place in a product, with clear measurements of whether it works.
benefits: Dashboards your team will actually use

sections.heading: Where we help
bullets: Document and email processing with LLMs

title: Fintech & Compliance Systems
summary: Secure platforms built for HKMA and FSC requirements.
intro: We build onboarding, payments and reporting systems for fintech companies and financial institutions, with security and compliance designed in from the start.
Our team is familiar with HKMA and Taiwan FSC expectations for technology risk, outsourcing and cloud use.
benefits: Security designed in from day one
Experience with HKMA and FSC requirements

title: Dedicated Engineering Teams
summary: Extra engineers who work as part of your own team.
intro: When you need more engineering capacity, we provide developers, QA and DevOps engineers who join your team, use your tools and follow your process.
You get the flexibility of an external team with the continuity of an internal one: the same people, month after month.
benefits: Works inside your tools and process
